# A planned Plugin stop drains finite work while Core and other Plugins stay available

## 1. Install the fixture and Elevation Plugins and start

## 2. Start work the fixture holds


## 3. Begin a planned stop; the fixture quiesces and pauses ingestion

Observed fixture while stopping:
```json
{
  "admitting": false,
  "ingesting": false,
  "held": 1
}
```

## 4. While stopping, the fixture refuses new work and everything else is available

SDK `GET /plugins` with <operator key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "availability": "available",
      "capabilities": [
        "elevation.lookup"
      ],
      "id": "elevation",
      "release": "1.0.0"
    },
    {
      "availability": "unavailable",
      "capabilities": [
        "fixture.work"
      ],
      "id": "fixture",
      "release": "1.0.0"
    }
  ]
}
```

Observed availability:
```json
{
  "elevation": "available",
  "fixture": "unavailable"
}
```

## 5. Releasing the held work lets the stop finish with its outcome kept

SDK `GET /plugins/fixture/operations/<id-2>` with <operator key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "capability": "fixture.work",
  "created_at": "<time>",
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "error": null,
  "id": "<id-2>",
  "input": {
    "hold": true,
    "label": "held"
  },
  "output": {
    "label": "held",
    "stage": "done"
  },
  "plugin_id": "fixture",
  "plugin_release": "1.0.0",
  "status": "completed",
  "submission_id": "<held>"
}
```

Observed running services:
```json
[
  "core",
  "plugin-elevation"
]
```

## 6. Starting the fixture again makes it available
